about: Paint guide for assets/models/player.glb. Pixel rects are in the texture's own pixels, top-left origin (the same space as a canvas drawImage). glTF textures load with flipY=false, so a CanvasTexture used as a replacement map must also set flipY=false.

jersey.body_color: multiply or fill the whole texture with uniforms.*.jersey_body, keep the blank's shading
jersey.orientation: front and back panels are stored upside down: the neck is at the bottom of the image and the hem at the top. Draw anything on them flipped vertically (scale(1,-1)). Left-to-right order is NOT mirrored.

pants.stripe_mask_note: white = stripe (uniforms.*.pants_stripe), black = pants colour. Same pixel layout as the pants texture.

socks.note: the sock mesh samples this strip; fill it with uniforms.*.socks

helmet.note: plain colour, no texture in the GLB. UVs are a spherical map: u runs around the helmet (0.5 = front, 0.75 = player's left side, 0.25 = player's right side, seam at the back), v runs bottom to top. To add decals, build a canvas, fill it with helmet_shell, draw the logo in the rects below and set it as material.map (flipY=false).
helmet.canvas_note: use a 2:1 canvas so one pixel covers the same arc in u and v; draw logos with their own aspect (contain) inside the rect

left.note: image right edge points to the back of the helmet; flip x so a logo faces forward

right.note: image right edge points to the front of the helmet

helmet.decal_uv_note: uv = [u0, v0_top, u1, v1_bottom] in glTF texture space (v down, same as canvas y / height).

facemask.note: plain colour (uniforms.*.facemask). Includes the chin cup.

misc.note: skin, shoes, arm sleeve, wristbands, visor. Not team painted.
